63522-the-amazing-city.title: The Amazing City
63522-the-amazing-city.creator: John F. Macdonald
63522-the-amazing-city.description: A book by John F. Macdonald. In my almost daily perambulations through the brilliant, through the drab, and through the ambiguous quarters of Paris, I constantly come upon street scenes that bring me inquisitively to a standstill. Not that they are particularly novel or startling. Indeed, to the Parisian they are such banal, everyday spectacles that he passes them by without so much as a glance.

70902-many-happy-returns-of-the-day.title: Of The Day!
70902-many-happy-returns-of-the-day.creator: Unknown
70902-many-happy-returns-of-the-day.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. My own birthday, the one I keep for my private use, comes on the fifth day of December, rain or shine, even when that day falls on Sunday. I have had it since 1869, and it is getting thin in spots and is not as fresh and crisp as it was.

arxiv-2104-00351.title: TrajeVAE : Controllable Human Motion Generation from Trajectories
arxiv-2104-00351.creator: Kacper Kania, Marek Kowalski, Tomasz Trzciński
arxiv-2104-00351.description: Abstract The creation of plausible and controllable 3D human motion animations is a long-standing problem that requires a manual intervention of skilled artists. Current machine learning approaches can semi-automate the process, however, they are limited in a significant way: they can handle only a single trajectory of the expected motion that precludes fine-grained control over the output.

arxiv-2108-03516.title: A Geometric Interpretation to Fixed-Point Theory on S b S_{b} -Metric Spaces
arxiv-2108-03516.creator: Hülya AYTİMUR, Nihal TAŞ
arxiv-2108-03516.description: Abstract . In this paper we present some fixed-figure theorems as a geometric approach to the fixed-point theory when the number of fixed points of a self-mapping is more than one. To do this, we modify the Jleli-Samet type contraction and define new contractions on S b S_{b} -metric spaces.

arxiv-2210-05789.title: Trading Off Resource Budgets For Improved Regret Bounds
arxiv-2210-05789.creator: Damon FalckUniversity of Oxford damon.falck@gmail.com, Thomas OrtonUniversity of Oxford thomas.orton@cs.ox.ac.uk
arxiv-2210-05789.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Damon FalckUniversity of Oxford damon.falck@gmail.com, Thomas OrtonUniversity of Oxford thomas.orton@cs.ox.ac.uk. In this work we consider a variant of adversarial online learning where in each round one picks B B out of N N arms and incurs cost equal to the minimum of the costs of each arm chosen.

arxiv-2212-02449.title: Cross-dimensional valley excitons from Förster coupling in arbitrarily twisted stacks of monolayer semiconductors
arxiv-2212-02449.creator: Ci Li, Wang Yao
arxiv-2212-02449.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ci Li, Wang Yao. In stacks of transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers with arbitrary twisting angles, we explore a new class of bright excitons arising from the pronounced Förster coupling, whose dimensionality is tuned by its in-plane momentum. The low energy sector at small momenta is two-dimensional, featuring a Mexican Hat dispersion, while the high energy sector at larger momenta becomes three-dimensional (3D) with sizable group velocity both in-plane and out-of-plane.

arxiv-2305-09221.title: A Multi-Client Searchable Encryption Scheme for IoT Environment*
arxiv-2305-09221.creator: Nazatul H. Sultan, Shabnam Kasra-Kermanshahi, Yen Tran, Shangqi Lai, Vijay Varadharajan, Surya Nepal, Xun Yi
arxiv-2305-09221.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nazatul H. Sultan, Shabnam Kasra-Kermanshahi, Yen Tran, Shangqi Lai, Vijay Varadharajan, Surya Nepal, Xun Yi. The proliferation of connected devices through Internet connectivity presents both opportunities for smart applications and risks to security and privacy. It is vital to proactively address these concerns to fully leverage the potential of the Internet of Things. IoT services where one data owner serves multiple clients, like smart city transportation, smart building management and healthcare can offer benefits but also bring cybersecurity and data privacy risks.

arxiv-2308-07411.title: Exploring the Intersection of Large Language Models and Agent-Based Modeling via Prompt Engineering
arxiv-2308-07411.creator: Edward Junprung
arxiv-2308-07411.description: Abstract The final frontier for simulation is the accurate representation of complex, real-world social systems. While agent-based modeling (ABM) seeks to study the behavior and interactions of agents within a larger system, it is unable to faithfully capture the full complexity of human-driven behavior.

arxiv-2312-07483.title: Turning Earth into Venus: A Stochastic Model of Possible Evolutions of Terrestrial Topography Journal: AAS Journals astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ) , cartopy ( Met Office 2015 ) , dynesty ( Speagle 2019 ) , numpy ( van der Walt et al. 2011 ) , scipy ( Jones et al. 2001 ; McKinney 2010
arxiv-2312-07483.creator: Arthur D. Adams, Gregory P. Laughlin
arxiv-2312-07483.description: Abstract Venus may have had both an Earth-like climate as well as extensive water oceans and active (or incipient) plate tectonics for an extended interval of its history. The topographical power spectrum of Venus provides important clues to the planet’s past evolution.

arxiv-2401-11696.title: Self-interaction corrected SCAN functional for molecules and solids in the numeric atom-center orbital framework
arxiv-2401-11696.creator: Sheng Bi, Christian Carbogno, Igor Ying Zhang, Matthias Scheffler
arxiv-2401-11696.description: Abstract Semilocal density-functional approximations (DFAs), including the state-of-the-art SCAN functional, are plagued by the self-interaction error (SIE). While this error is explicitly defined only for one-electron systems, it has inspired the self-interaction correction method proposed by Perdew and Zunger (PZ-SIC), which has shown promise in mitigating the many-electron SIE. However, the PZ-SIC method is known for its significant numerical instability.

arxiv-2404-00592.description: Abstract The Cabibbo-Kobayashi-Maskawa (CKM) matrix elements | V c ​ d | |V_{cd}| and | V c ​ s | |V_{cs}| are essential to test the unitary of CKM matrix. arxiv-2407-09101.title: Resistance, oddness and colouring defect of snarks
arxiv-2407-09101.creator: Imran Allie
arxiv-2407-09101.description: Abstract Let G G be a bridgeless cubic graph. The resistance of G G , denoted r ⁡ ( G ) r(G) , is the minimum number of edges which can be removed from G G in order to render 3-edge-colourability.

arxiv-2411-10991.title: Modulating Reservoir Dynamics via Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Robot Skill Synthesis
arxiv-2411-10991.creator: Zahra Koulaeizadeh, Erhan Oztop
arxiv-2411-10991.description: Abstract A random recurrent neural network, called a reservoir, can be used to learn robot movements conditioned on context inputs that encode task goals. The Learning is achieved by mapping the random dynamics of the reservoir modulated by context to desired trajectories via linear regression.

arxiv-2512-16577.title: CRONOS: Continuous time reconstruction for 4D medical longitudinal series
arxiv-2512-16577.creator: Nico Albert Disch, Saikat Roy, Constantin Ulrich, Yannick Kirchhoff, Maximilian Rokuss, Robin Peretzke, David Zimmerer, Klaus Maier-Hein
arxiv-2512-16577.description: Abstract Forecasting how 3D medical scans evolve over time is important for disease progression, treatment planning, and developmental assessment. Yet existing models either rely on a single prior scan, fixed grid times, or target global labels, which limits voxel-level forecasting under irregular sampling.

pmc-10582719.title: Levodopa-induced dyskinesia: interplay between the N-methyl-D-aspartic acid receptor and neuroinflammation
pmc-10582719.creator: Fanshi Zhang, Mei Liu, Jinmei Tuo, Li Zhang, Jun Zhang, Changyin Yu, Zucai Xu
pmc-10582719.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a common neurodegenerative disorder of middle-aged and elderly people, clinically characterized by resting tremor, myotonia, reduced movement, and impaired postural balance. Clinically, patients with PD are often administered levodopa (L-DOPA) to improve their symptoms. However, after years of L-DOPA treatment, most patients experience complications of varying severity, including the “on-off phenomenon”, decreased efficacy, and levodopa-induced dyskinesia (LID).

pmc-10632454.title: Spatial transcriptomics uncover sucrose post-phloem transport during maize kernel development
pmc-10632454.creator: Yuxin Fu, Wenxin Xiao, Lang Tian, Liangxing Guo, Guangjin Ma, Chen Ji, Yongcai Huang, Haihai Wang, Xingguo Wu, Tao Yang, Jiechen Wang, Jirui Wang, Yongrui Wu, Wenqin Wang
pmc-10632454.description: Maize kernels are complex biological systems composed of three genetic sources, namely maternal tissues, progeny embryos, and progeny endosperms. The lack of gene expression profiles with spatial information has limited the understanding of the specific functions of each cell population, and hindered the exploration of superior genes in kernels.

pmc-10637732.title: Assessing bone mineral density in children and adolescents living with HIV and on treatment with tenofovir disoproxil fumarate: a systematic review
pmc-10637732.creator: Maria Brennda Ferreira de Gusmão, Vinícius Vital de Oliveira, Natália Maria da Silva Santos, Luciana Costa Melo
pmc-10637732.description: Objective:To investigate the impact of tenofovir disoproxil fumarate on bone mineral density and bone mineral content in children and adolescents infected with the human immunodeficiency virus.Data source:The search procedure was performed according to the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Statement.

pmc-11322163.title: Monthly electricity consumption data at 1 km × 1 km grid for 280 cities in China from 2012 to 2019
pmc-11322163.creator: Xiaoqin Yan, Zhou Huang, Shuliang Ren, Ganmin Yin, Junnan Qi
pmc-11322163.description: High spatio-temporal resolution estimates of electricity consumption are essential for formulating effective energy transition strategies. However, the data availability is limited by complex spatio-temporal heterogeneity and insufficient multi-source feature fusion. To address these issues, this study introduces an innovative downscaling method that combines multi-source data with machine learning and spatial interpolation techniques.

pmc-11417742.title: Cyberchondria, Health Literacy, and Perception of Risk in Croatian Patients with Risk of Sexually Transmitted Infections and HIV—A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11417742.creator: Tanja Staraj Bajcic, Iva Sorta-Bilajac Turina, Marko Lucijanic, Tamara Sinozic, Mirela Vuckovic, Ksenija Bazdaric, Francisco Guillén-Grima
pmc-11417742.description: Background: The perception of the risk of sexually transmitted infections (STIs) is a well-researched phenomenon, but not in relation to cyberchondria and health literacy. Therefore, our aim was to examine the association between the assessment of the risk of sexually transmitted diseases and HIV, cyberchondria, and health literacy. Materials and methods: This study was conducted in 2020–2021 in Croatia.

pmc-11431746.title: Poly(acrylic acid)-Sodium Alginate Superabsorbent Hydrogels Synthesized by Electron-Beam Irradiation—Part II: Swelling Kinetics and Absorption Behavior in Various Swelling Media
pmc-11431746.creator: Elena Manaila, Gabriela Craciun
pmc-11431746.description: Hybrid hydrogels with superabsorbent properties based on acrylic acid (20%), sodium alginate (0.5%) and poly(ethylene oxide) (0.1%) were obtained by electron-beam irradiation between 5 and 20 kGy, and are characterized by different physical and chemical methods; the first results reported showed gel fractions over 87%, cross-link densities under 9.9 × 103 mol/cm3 and swelling degrees of 400 g/g.

pmc-12437945.title: A case report of delirium tremens in a patient with myasthenia gravis
pmc-12437945.creator: V Palinić, M Krešić Ćorić, N Zovko
pmc-12437945.description: IntroductionThis report describes a case of delirium tremens in a 35-year-old male patient with myasthenia gravis and epilepsy. He first came to our clinic on 18th of August 2024. His complaints were of bad mood, nervousness and loss of will and appetite, he started to drink alcohol. He was advised to quit drinking and was prescribed quetiapine.

pmc-12470557.title: Assessment of Gait Disorders in Cerebral Small Vessel Disease: Advantages of Different Clinical Scales
pmc-12470557.creator: Larisa A. Dobrynina, Elina T. Bitsieva, Kamila V. Shamtieva, Maryam R. Zabitova, Marina V. Krotenkova
pmc-12470557.description: Background/Objectives: Cerebral small vessel disease (cSVD) is one of the leading causes of gait disorders (GDs) in the elderly. Clinical diversity and lack of standardization in assessment of GDs in cSVD patients are associated with late diagnosis. The comparative value of clinical rating scales used for gait assessment in clinical studies of cSVD has not been previously clarified.

pmc-12672456.title: Therapeutic potential of common Phytoestrogens found in traditional Chinese medicine in chronic kidney diseases
pmc-12672456.creator: Tongtong Liu, Minghan Li
pmc-12672456.description: In recent years, phytoestrogens in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM)—a class of estrolike active components naturally occurring in medicinal plants—have gradually emerged as a research hotspot in the treatment of various diseases due to their multi-target regulatory potential. These metabolites are abundant in TCM, and an increasing body of evidence indicates that they have beneficial effects in chronic kidney diseases.

pmc-13546064.title: Multidisciplinary Management of Severe Taxane-Induced Nail Toxicity in a Breast Cancer Patient
pmc-13546064.creator: Natalia Sauer, Marta Kowalczuk, Adrian Arkada, Jacek Calik
pmc-13546064.description: IntroductionTaxane-induced nail toxicity (TINT) is a relatively common but often underreported adverse effect of docetaxel-based chemotherapy that may significantly impair quality of life and functional status. Severe cases can require structured supportive care involving multiple clinical disciplines. We present a case of high-grade TINT in a patient with breast cancer successfully managed with a multidisciplinary supportive approach.
